balls.text: length ball on sixth stump, heaves a pull to deep square leg and they jog a single.
length ball on fifth stump slapped to long-off for one.

Dhoni's innings is short and sweet! Length ball wide outside off on the guideline, tries to repeat his first ball slash over third man for six but comes off the toe and swirls to Bishnoi coming in off the sweeper rope for his second catch of the over, taken on his knees 10 yards in from the rope.

back-to-back! And into the upper deck over square leg!  Wood challenges Dhoni with a bouncer on sixth stump, Dhoni fetches this, chews it up and spits the bone back out 30 yards over the leg side rope.
the fans are barking mad now! Length ball on eighth stump, slashed over wide deep third man and clears the rope. What a noise in Chepauk with Dhoni getting off the mark with a maximum.

length ball outside leg stump at 143 kph, Jadeja goes to pull and skies this to deep midwicket. Simple catch taken by Bishnoi jogging in from the rope before settling on his knees 10 yards in for a catch on his haunches.
118 kph slower bouncer on fourth stump, pulled flat to deep square leg for one.
139 kph delivery lands full and wide, sliced to Krunal at cover sweeper for one.
slower short ball on fifth stump, Rayudu uppercuts this barely clearing Avesh Khan at short third man leaping up in vain before going to the rope.
full on sixth stump, driven to long-on for one.
full on fourth stump at 136 kph, heaves this to deep midwicket along the ground for one.
slower ball back of a length at 121 kph on sixth stump, tapped wide of extra cover for one.
short ball on the body, goes to pull and hustled for pace on a pull at 148 kph, hits Jadeja in the shoulder and caroms to deep third for an extra.
goes for yorker and an ankle high full toss at 150 kph is flicked flat to deep square leg for one.
full on middle, Rayudu charges and buries this with a drive into the sightscreen.
back of a length outside leg stump, Jadeja goes back to flick and misses off the pads. The ball dribbles behind point for an extra.
short on fifth stump at 142 kph, Rayudu shuffles across trying to repeat the shot but misses off the gloves floating wide of Pooran's left for one.
back of a length on fourth stump at 143 kph, Rayudu shuffles across and whips this wristily and flat over backward square leg clearing the rope easily.

slower ball fools Stokes at 123 kph on a fullish length on off stump. Stokes goes to heave this over midwicket but skies a top edge to short third on the ring. Simple catch taken by Thakur bending on his haunches.
in the slot on fifth stump at 135 kph, Stokes smokes this flat over mid-off in the ring and it goes one bounce over the rope.
yorker on off stump at 132 kph, jammed out back down the pitch past the bowler to long-on for one.
yorker on fifth stump at 136 kph, stabbed out to the cover sweeper for one.
short on middle, shuffles across the stumps to get inside the line pulling to deep backward square leg for one.
fullish length ball on the legs, charges and heaves to long-on for one.
charges to convert this into a low full toss on seventh stump and slaps back to Bishnoi for a dot.
full on middle, slog sweep connects sweetly and goes over square leg to the rope on two bounces.
back of a length on seventh stump, cuts this straight to backward point for none.
flighted full on sixth stump, goes to sweep and misses.
Moeen charges a good length ball and keeps running to the dugout. Nowhere near the pitch of this googly on middle and it spins past Moeen's heave as well as off stump for a simple stumping by Pooran.
googly land short and wide on seventh stump, cut behind point for one.
full and well outside leg past a sweep, wide called.

best in show! Pure class from Moeen to round out a hat-trick of fours. Wide yorker attempted by Avesh but Moeen one-ups up by using the pace to guide this delicately between backward point and a very fine short third man splitting the gap to the rope.
slower length ball on seventh stump, slapped wide of the fielder at extra cover to the wide long-off rope.
length ball spanked on the up on seventh stump at 127 kph, cover sweeper Bishnoi races like a greyhound to his left but still can't stop it.
back of a length on the hips, flicked through midwicket for one.
back of a length outside leg stump, charges before adjusting to this 129 kph delivery and fighting it off to cover for none.
length ball on fourth stump, punched toward mid-off for one.
google on a good length on off spins toward fifth stump and is defended to backward point.

googly flighted full on leg stump giving it more air again at 93 kph, Dube goes for another booming slog and top edges this spinning away from him with the ball swirling off the bat toward short third man. Very basic catch taken by Wood this time on the ring waiting for the ball to come down at head height.
slows up the pace on a googly flighted at 95 kph on a fullish length on off stump, goes for another heave and misses as the ball goes just past off stump.
fuller, straighter and quicker at 102 kph, but not quick enough to beat Dube who cranks this flat over long-on.
good length ball sits up on fifth stump, Dube winds up and destroys this over wide long-on, it screams into the facade of the windows on the suites on that side of the ground.
googly lands on a good length well outside leg, Moeen prods forward and a thick edge goes behind point for one.
the bark is back in the CSK innings! Back of a length on fifth stump, sits up to be pulled fiercely over wide long-on, one bounce over the rope.
Dube dooby dooo.... Full on fifth stump, winds up and smokes this flat over the bowler's head and just clears the rope.
short ball on fifth stump at 133 kph, goes to pull again but misses.
back of a length on fourth stump, goes to pull and plays over the top of this going through to the keeper.
length ball on sixth stump, slapped to the cover sweeper for one.
back of a length on sixth stump, slapped to wide long-off for one.
good length ball on off, defended back to Bishnoi.
full on leg stump, flicked through wide long-on and they charge for a tight two.
googly lands on a good length on fourth stump, goes to muscle this over mid-on but splices a pull toward long-off for one.
good length well outside leg, goes back to flick into midwicket for one.
googly lands on a good length on leg and spins sharply past Moeen's forward prod and fizzes just past off stump too.
full outside leg, goes to heave to midwicket and drags this to fine leg for a quick single. Throw to the keeper's end is wide of the stumps just enough to allow the run to be completed safely.
back of a length on middle, guided to backward point for one.
back of a length on fourth stump at 140 kph, leans back to guide this with an open face to deep third for one.
144 kph bouncer over fourth stump, left alone.
back of a length on fourth stump, Moeen goes to pull and drags this into midwicket along the ground for one.

Krunal and Wood team up to put a leash on Conway! Short ball on the stumps, hustled for pace trying to pull over midwicket, it hangs up in the air long enough for Krunal to charge in off the rope covering 20 yards before putting in a diving effort to latch onto this at ankle height. Superb effort!
tries to slip in a slower ball at 122 back of a length on fourth stump, but Conway tennis backhand swats this back down the ground to make the long-on fielder fetch it over the rope.
length ball on fifth stump, pulls this flat through wide midwicket for two. But Pooran can't handle the relay cleanly and they'll take a third on the misfielded backup.
googly again on a good length on fifth stump punched to Mayers at extra cover for none.
good length ball on off, pushes at this and a thick edge goes wide of slip to short third for one.
googly spins away on a good length on fifth stump, punched to extra cover and a diving stop denies a run.
back of a length ball on fifth stump, punches toward the off side for none.

and right away, Bishnoi finally collars one of the openers! Fullish length ball flighted on fifth stump, Gaikwad goes for a slog sweep over midwicket and the turn away plus some extra bounce produces a top edge that swirls to short third man. Tremendous athletic take by the fielder leaping up to reach high above his head while backpedaling from the edge of the circle.
112 kph slower length ball on middle, pulls this flat to deep backward square leg for one.
length ball on off stump at 136 kph, late on a pull and hit on the thigh before it caroms to point for an extra.
slower length ball on fifth stump at 112 kph, slices this to the cover sweeper for one.
slower length ball on fifth stump at 112 kph, opens the face to guide this behind point for one.
length ball on fifth stump at 135 kph, slapped to the cover sweeper for one.
short ball on the stumps, Gaikwad comes down the track to pull and top edges this barely wide of short fine leg to the rope.

do we need a golden retriever to find where that landed?! Full again on sixth stump, Conway stands a bit more upright this time winding up to spank this over wide long-on into the gap between the grandstand entrance.
back of a length on fourth stump, punched back to Krunal for none.
flighted full and wide on seventh stump, Conway winds up and launches a slog sweep way over the rope at wide long-on.
good length ball on the legs, goes to flick and misses as the ball caroms to point and they take a leg bye.
charges a fullish length ball slanted wide across Conway from around the wicket on eighth stump, slaps this on the up to long-off for one.
fullish length on middle, driven down the ground to long-on for one bringing up consecutive half-centuries, this time off 25 balls.
fullish length on off at 140 kph, smokes a drive back to the bowler who gets a hand on it in his follow-through to slow it down toward long-off for one.

full and angled into middle and off while tumbling to the ground by Thakur at 141 kph, flicked through mid-on for one. The siren goes off. Not because the dog is back on the field but rather for a no ball. Enormous overstep on the replay. A good four or five inches.
short on sixth stump at 136 kph, pulled to wide midwicket for one.
119 kph slower length ball on fourth stump, Gaikwad pushes at this with hard hands a touch early and a leading edge balloons just wide of the non-striker out of reach of Thakur.
short on the body, goes to pull and it comes off the gloves behind square leg for one.
141 kph delivery lands back of a length on sixth stump, pulled through wide midwicket for one.
114 kph delivery full on off, driven to long-on for one.
good length ball on off at 145 kph, punched firmly but straight to mid-off for none.
length ball on the hips, a howling good flick is timed exquisitely that sails flat over the rope at backward square leg.
back of a length at 142 kph on fourth stump, tap and run in front of point for one.
length ball sits up on off stump at 140 kph, Conway laps this up with a pull that is laced through backward square to the rope.
bouncer on fourth stump, Conway goes to pull and there's a sound as it passes the bat and sails over the keeper. Looked like an edge but has been given as four byes.
ruufffffff start for the English fast bowler...  Fullish length ball on fifth stump, driven on the up with class through extra cover to the rope.

take a bow wow wowwwwwww! Comes down the track with elegant footwork to drive a full ball on sixth stump high and wide over the extra cover rope. He's struck it so clean he's nailed the back driver side door of the sponsor car on the platform above the boundary. There's a huge dent in it now.
fuller and straighter on the stumps, shovels this high over mid-off, slapped back just inside the rope to keep this to two.
ow ow ow owwwwwwww!!!! Launches this over long-off! Flighted too full and wide on eighth stump, Gaikwad digs his heels in and drives way over the wide long-off rope.
back of a length on sixth stump, sticks in the wicket a touch and plays this late nudging it to extra cover for none.
woof woof! What a shot! Length ball on middle, backs away a touch to create room to free the arms and just muscles this flat over the bowler into the sightscreen.
slants this across full on sixth stump, drives straight to extra cover for none.
good length ball on the legs, flicked through midwicket along the ground this time for one.
drag-down on middle, picks the length early and yanks a pull over midwicket to the rope.
back of a length on fourth stump, punches flat-footed to extra cover for none.
short on the legs, pulls this behind square leg for one.
back of a length on fourth stump, miscues a pull to mid-on for none.
back of a length at 94 kph on fourth stump, punched toward extra cover, diving effort slips off the hands and trickles away for one.
back of a length on the hips, flicked through midwicket for one.
overpitched on off, drills this drive straight to mid-off, diving stop on the ring keeps it to one.
good length ball on the stumps at 125 kph, punched gently through mid-on for one.
back of a length on the hips, flicked through backward square leg for two.
full and wide, just uses the pace to guide this with an open face through point to the rope.
length ball at 127 kph on fourth stump, tap and run into the covers for one.
good length ball on fifth stump at 132 kph, pushes this and runs for a tight single to mid-off.
back of a length at 136 kph on fifth stump seaming away, goes to cut and misses.
well that's a doggone spectacular cover drive! Overpitched on fifth stump, strokes this beautifully through the gap at extra cover to the rope.
length ball angled across sixth stump at 134 kph, slapped behind square through point to the rope.
good length ball on off, defended.

full on middle at 132 kph, flicked through midwicket for what should be two but a fumble by the boundary rider turns it into three. No ball called by the on field umpire on an overstep and a free hit is coming up for Conway. Confusion here now. No ball was clearly called on field but apparently has been rescinded by the third umpire. Bizarre.

full and swinging well down leg past a flick at 132 kph. No chance for the keeper and it goes for five wides. KL Rahul has called for a review thinking it has come off the pads and should be a legal delivery. He's going to lose this.  Definite gap between bat and pad. The crowd is going bonkers as nothing is showing up on UltraEdge. Who knew that a review for wides could whip the crowd into a frenzy.
full and wide yorker length on the guideline at 127 kph, goes to jam this out through point but an inside edge goes through fine leg for one.
full on fifth stump at 125 kph, punched to mid-off, fielder connects with a direct hit but the runner was safely in for the single.
full and swinging in toward middle again at 123 kph, punched through wide mid-on for one.
good length ball on fourth stump, punched away through cover for one.
length ball on seventh stump at 122 kph, goes to cut and skids a touch low under the shot.
125 kph good length ball seaming way outside off, wide called as the keeper collects in front of slip.
full and swinging in toward middle at 134 kph, punched off a thick inside edge caroming off the pad back down the pitch past the non-striker for one to mid-on.
length ball on middle, Wood backs away and slaps this flat over extra cover for six. Extraordinary shot, if only it mattered to the final result. CSK hold on by 12 runs.
full on sixth stump, drives high over wide long-off, one bounce over the rope.
length ball on fifth stump, goes to drive inside out and misses.
full on middle, skies a drive high in the air swirling wide of Dhoni's right. He shuffles over toward the edge of the ring at short third to take a simple catch.
length ball follows him backing away from leg stump and clears both an inside out drive and leg stump.
121 kph slower ball full on off stump, launches this high over midwicket and it plops dead well short of the boundary rider for two.
yorker speared into the legs, can't flick this away and a leg bye goes to point for one. The siren goes off! No ball called on an overstep. The crowd is aghast!
bouncer outside off, wide called on height.
full toss on the wide guideline at knee height, shuffles way across his stumps to scoop this over backward square leg. Diving stop on the rope for two.
full on eighth stump, drives to wide long-off for two.

goes for yorker on fifth stump, sends in an ankle high full toss that is reverse scooped over third man. Gaikwad charges across from the rope at deep third man to stop this just inside the rope to save two valuable runs.
full and way outside the guideline, Gowtham drives hard at this but it's well out of reach. Wide called again.
full and wide, goes to drive and misses again as this one slides just inside the guideline.
full and outside the wide guideline, another wide called.
full and wide hugging the guideline, goes to drive and misses.
wide yorker, sprayed outside the guideline for another free extra.

full and wide on the guideline, slices a drive skied high toward Jadeja at point sweeper. If it was a World Cup or IPL Final, he'd have put in a dive but he stays on his feet after charging in and lets it short hop him for a single.
length ball on the stumps, flicked to the leg side for one.
full on off, miscues a drive down the ground to long-off for one.
back of a length on fifth stump, shuffles across to punch to long-on for one.
full on middle, driven to wide midwicket for a sharp two.
slower bouncer on fifth stump, pulled to short fine leg for one.
back of a length on the stumps, flicked to wide long-on for one.
full and heaved to wide long-on, Stokes overruns the ball but a good backup by a teammate coming across from deep midwicket keeps this to two instead of four.

dropped! Dube over short third man! Chahar goes for wide yorker again. Gowtham tries to heave this over midwicket and splices this off the toe swirling behind point. Dube jogs 15 yards along the ring but his feet are a bit tangled and he almost overruns this. As a result, his hands are in a tangle and not in a good position to reach for this coming back across his body. It clangs out badly. He made a straightforward chance look extremely difficult.
length ball on fifth stump, slapped wide of the sweeper for two.
Chahar gets punished after being challenged to attack the stumps! Full on middle, Gowtham winds up and clobbers this high and deep over midwicket.
another wide yorker speared outside the guideline. Wide called for the third ball in a row. Crowd groans.
length ball pushed way outside the guideline again, wide called.
wide yorker lands outside the guideline, wide called.
length ball wide outside off, slapped past extra cover and Santner at cover sweeper has to work hard to track it down to save two runs.
short and wide, slapped to the point sweeper for one.

goes for wide yorker again, doesn't get it full enough and Pooran smokes a blistering drive flat to wide long-off. However, he doesn't get the elevation on it. Stokes on the boundary comes in initially before going back and takes a head height catch two yards in from the rope. If he's not there, it's thudding into the ads for six.
back of a length on middle, goes back to tap to long-on for one.
short on the legs, flicked into vacant midwicket for a very sharp two.
good length ball on the hips, flicked to deep backward square leg for two.
full and wide again, Pooran stays stationary to slice this with an open face to the point sweeper for one.
full and wide yorker, Pooran shuffles way outside off trying to scoop this over fine leg but miscues this straight to the fielder on the ring.
good length ball on the legs, flicked behind square leg for one.

no no, this is the shot of the day! Reverse sweep into the front row of the third tier/upper deck! Full on off stump, Pooran premeditates getting into position to annihilate this over point. The crowd gasps at his brilliance coming up against a CSK legend.
quicker ball on a good length on seventh stump, Pooran winds up again but miscues a slog into his feet.
shot of the day! Length ball on the wide guideline, Pooran cranks this flat over extra cover into the LCD ad boards.
good length ball on seventh stump, goes for a big heave and misses.
full on fifth stump, prodded into the covers for one.
back of a length on fourth stump, goes back to tap into mid-on for one.
full on middle, tap and run into cover for one.
back of a length on off, goes back and across to flick behind square leg for one.
back of a length on fourth stump, spins very sharply down leg for a wide.
back of a length on the legs, shuffles across to flick through midwicket for one.
bullseye! Good length ball on the stumps, Stoinis backs away from leg trying to heave over wide long-on and misses. The ball spins in and leg stump is knocked back just under the bails.
good length ball pulled to deep square leg for two.
good length ball on fourth stump, tries to tap and run behind point but mistimes this into the ground for none.
short on the stumps, pulled to long-on for one.
length ball on the wide guideline, slapped to extra cover for none.
length ball on fifth stump, slapped to mid-off for none.
fullish length heaved to deep backward square leg for one.
length ball slapped to wide long-off for one.
short on the stumps, goes to pull but lack of pace on the ball means Pooran is through the shot too early and hit on the chest before it dribbles for none.
full on eighth stump, Pooran winds up and creams this high over extra cover, two bounces to the rope.
137 kph length ball on the wide guideline, Pooran shuffles across to get in line and laces this behind point racing quickly to the rope.
in the slog on fourth stump, Pooran winds up and deposits a big heave eight rows back into the seats over midwicket.
back of a length on fifth stump, tapped defensively to backward point for none.
back of a length on the stumps, tapped into the ring for one.
back of a length on sixth stump, tapped wide of extra cover for one.
back of a length on the legs, tap and run behind square leg for one.
full on sixth stump, driven square to the sweeper for one.
back of a length on fifth stump, tap and run with an open face to short third for one.
length ball on fourth stump, backs away to slap through the off side for one.
full on off, prodded softly to extra cover for none.

fullish length on fifth stump, charges and lofts a drive down the ground but doesn't middle it that well, comes off more of the inner half of the bat and picks out Jadeja two yards inside the rope at head height for a basic catch.
fullish length on fifth stump, punched to extra cover for none.
short and wide, slapped to deep backward point for one.
back of a length on the legs, punched to long-on for one.
back of a length on the legs, tapped gently behind square for one.
massive strike! Full on fourth stump, winds up and launches this into the second tier over wide long-on.
back of a length on fifth stump, punched to the sweeper for one.
back of a length on sixth stump, slapped behind point for two.
good length ball spinning into the hips, goes to pull and misses off the body before the carom goes behind square for one.
full on middle, charges this and launches a drive to wide long-on. Gaikwad leaps in the air to try to swat this back into play but it just barely clears him and thuds into the LCD ad boards.
flighted full on fifth stump, driven to long-off for one.
full on off, flicked through midwicket for one.
back of a length on middle, goes back to punch to long-on for one.
good length ball on off, uses his feet to punch to extra cover again for none.
good length ball on off, prodded to extra cover for none.
good length ball on off, Stoinis plays the reverse paddle first ball and glances it fine to short third for one.

fullish length ball on middle, Rahul slog sweeps this to wide midwicket. Doesn't come close to getting enough juice on the shot and Gaikwad ranges to his left to take this 15 yards inside the rope at rib height.
good length ball on the stumps, punched back to Moeen.

fullish length on fifth stump, tries to slog this over wide long-on but Stokes covers 15 yards to his right, settles and reaches up to snatch this at head height two yards in from the rope. If he wasn't there it was most likely landing just over the rope for six.
length ball, Hooda uses his feet coming forward and slices to backward point, diving stop on the ring for none.
full on off, punched through cover to the sweeper for one.
good length ball skidded on toward leg stump, Hooda backs away to drive but miscues this into the ground.
good length ball on middle, punched back to Santner off the back foot.
full on off, driven to long-off for one.
good length ball on off, shuffles across to chip over midwicket for one.
fullish length flighted on fifth stump, goes to drive and misses. Nearly overbalances out of the crease but keeps the back foot down as Dhoni takes the bails off just in case.
full on middle, flicked to midwicket for none.
full on off, slog sweeps this flat but picks out deep midwicket five yards inside the rope at head height. A ferocious half-century comes to an abrupt end. Conway hardly had to move for the catch.
good length ball on leg stump follows Rahul backing away from leg, punched to mid-off for one.

back of a length on fourth stump, punched to extra cover for what should be one, but a sloppy overthrow with no backup at the non-striker's end goes for four overthrows to make it five runs against Mayers, bringing up a 21-ball half-century.
119 kph length ball on fourth stump, pulls this high over midwicket, not timed cleanly but still gets enough bat on it to send it to the rope.
length ball on fifth stump, opens the face to guide this behind point to short third for one where a diving stop is made.
slower bouncer again on the wide guideline, but Mayers still is able to get plenty of bat on this with a tennis backhand swat through extra cover to the rope.
slower bouncer wide outside off, left alone and wide called.
slower ball at 119 kph lands short on fifth stump, Mayers not fooled and shuffles across to get inside the line and pulls this behind square to the rope.
back of a length on seventh stump, slapped wide of the cover sweeper for one.
back of a length on fifth stump, punched behind square wide of the cover sweeper for two.
142 kph ball lands full on eighth stump, driven to mid-on for one as a diving stop is made to save three.
length ball on the wide guideline at 137 kph, Mayers shuffles across to get in line and slaughters this deep over long-on. 91-meter strike thuds into the facade of the second level pavilion.
another attempted slower wide yorker sprayed way outside off at 114 kph, left alone and wide called. The crowd audibly groans....
knee high full toss on fourth stump at 142 kph, Mayers uses plenty of bottom hand to shovel this over mid-off to the rope.
full toss at knee height is sprayed wide outside the guidelines out of reach of Mayers trying to swat this through cover. Another wide, so the free hit remains.
half-volley on sixth stump, creams a drive to Chahar at extra cover who intercepts it for a dot. The siren goes off again though for another overstep by Deshpande. Another free hit on the way.
Wide yorker is sprayed almost off the pitch, another extra in the form of a wide and the free hit stays in play.
wide yorker, hugs the guideline at 140 kph, and Mayers can't stab it out through point. But the siren goes off as Deshpande has overstepped. Free hit to come.
length ball on sixth stump, slapped wide of the cover sweeper for two before Santner slides along the rope to stop it.
137 kph delivery lands as a length ball on sixth stump, slices this to backward point, knocked down on a bounce to save three runs.
good length ball on sixth stump, goes to punch it and is late.
another shin high full toss this time on seventh stump at 114 kph, but this time Chahar gets away with it punching straight to cover on the ring for none.
tries to angle in a yorker on fourth stump but it doesn't pitch and Mayers pokes this 129 kph delivery at shin height in the gap between mid-off and extra cover to the rope.
short on off, swivels to pull this crisply through square leg to the rope.
short and wide, too wide for Mayers to reach, wide called.
fullish length slower ball on fifth stump at 116 kph, Mayers waves in front of this a touch early and it beats him through to Dhoni.
length ball on sixth stump at 132 kph, punches this in the air at a catchable height but floats in the gap between cover and extra cover to the rope.
good length slower ball on middle, Mayers through the shot a touch early and chips this up softly but barely clears Chahar before falling short of mid-on for none.
full on the legs, flicked into midwicket for one.
133 kph delivery lands full on sixth stump, winds up and crunches this high and deep over wide long-off.
134 kph fullish length ball on fifth stump, laces a drive high over the non-striker down the ground to the mid-off rope.
length ball on sixth stump at 131 kph, Mayers slices a cut high over point to the rope. As loud as the crowd was 25 minutes ago when Dhoni was in the middle, you can almost hear a pin drop now.
131 kph back of a length on off, tapped through cover for one.
130 kph delivery lands back of a length on the legs, flicked wide of deep fine leg for two.
back of a length on middle, goes back to defend and some extra bounce gets Mayers in the gloves.
full and swinging away on fifth stump at 130 kph, driven to a cover sweeper for one.
short of a length and seaming in at 126 kph, pulled firmly through square leg to the rope.
full and swinging away sharply on eighth stump, Rahul flays this high over extra cover but it dribbles short of the rope and Gaikwad chases it down to keep it to two.
back of a length on fourth stump, defended to cover for none.
back of a length on sixth stump, punched to cover for none.
